sections.label: On the Bridal of Surya, and marriage ceremonies in general
sections.name: Book 14, hymn 1

verses.sa:
सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः ।
ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ ṛtenādityāstiṣṭhanti divi somo adhi śritaḥ
verses.en: Truth is the base that bears the earth; by Surya are the heavens upheld, By Law the Adityas stand secure, and Soma holds his place in heaven. l

verses.sa:
सोमेनादित्या बलिनः सोमेन पृथिवी मही।
अथो नक्षत्राणामेषामुपस्थे सोम आहितः॥
verses.tr: somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī atho nakṣatrāṇāmeṣāmupasthe soma āhitaḥ
verses.en: By Soma are the Adityas strong, by Soma mighty is the earth: Thus Soma in the lap of all these constellations hath 'his home.

verses.sa:
सोमं मन्यते पपिवान् यत् संपिंषन्त्योषधिम्।
सोमं यं ब्रह्माणो विदुर्न तस्याश्नाति पार्थिवः॥
verses.tr: somaṃ manyate papivān yat saṃpiṃṣantyoṣadhim somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidurna tasyāśnāti pārthivaḥ
verses.en: One thinks, when men have brayed the plant, that he hath drunk the Soma's juice. Of him whom Brahmans truly know as Soma never mortal eats.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वा सोम प्रपिबन्ति तत आ प्यायसे पुनः ।
वायुः सोमस्य रक्षिता समानां मास आकृतिः॥
verses.tr: yat tvā soma prapibanti tata ā pyāyase punaḥ vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ
verses.en: When they begin to drink thee, then, O God, thou swellest out again. Vayu is Soma's sentinel. The month is that which shapes the years,

verses.sa:
आच्छद्विधानैर्गुपितो बार्हतैः सोम रक्षितः ।
ग्राव्णामिच्छृण्वन् तिष्ठसि न ते अश्नाति पार्थिवः॥
verses.tr: ācchadvidhānairgupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ grāvṇāmicchṛṇvan tiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ
verses.en: Soma, preserved by coveriug rules, guarded by hymns in Brihati, Thou standest listening to the stones: none tastes of thee who dwells on earth. na ees The Real holdeth up the earth; or, Earth resteth on Reality.

verses.sa:
चित्तिरा उपबर्हणं चक्षुरा अभ्यञ्जनम्।
द्यौर्भूमिः कोश आसीद् यदयात् सूर्या पतिम्॥
verses.tr: cittirā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣurā abhyañjanam dyaurbhūmiḥ kośa āsīd yadayāt sūryā patim
verses.en: Thought was her coverlet, the power of sight was unguent for her eyes: Her treasure-chest was earth and heaven, when Surya went unto her lord.

verses.sa:
रैभ्यासीदनुदेयी नाराशंसी न्योचनी ।
सूर्याया भद्रमिद् वासो गाथयैति परिष्कृता॥
verses.tr: raibhyāsīdanudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī sūryāyā bhadramid vāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtā
verses.en: Raibhi was her dear bridal friend, and Narasansi led her home, i Lovely to see was Sarya's robe: by Gatha beautified she moves.

verses.sa:
स्तोमा आसन् प्रतिधयः कुरीरं छन्द ओपशः ।
सूर्याया अश्विना वराग्निरासीत् पुरोगवः॥
verses.tr: stomā āsan pratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ sūryāyā aśvinā varāgnirāsīt purogavaḥ
verses.en: Songs were the cross-bars of the pole, Kurira metre decked her head, Both Asvins were the paranymphs: Agni was leader of the train,

verses.sa:
सोमो वधूयुरभवदश्विनास्तामुभा वरा।
सूर्यां यत् पत्ये शंसन्तीं मनसा सविताददात्॥
verses.tr: somo vadhūyurabhavadaśvināstāmubhā varā sūryāṃ yat patye śaṃsantīṃ manasā savitādadāt
verses.en: Soma was he who wooed the maid: the groomsmen were both Asvins, when The Sun-god Savitar bestowed his willing Surya on her lord, L

verses.sa:
मनो अस्या अन आसीद् द्यौरासीदुत च्छदिः ।
शुक्रावनड्वाहावास्तां यदयात् सूर्या पतिम्॥
verses.tr: mano asyā ana āsīd dyaurāsīduta cchadiḥ śukrāvanaḍvāhāvāstāṃ yadayāt sūryā patim
verses.en: Her spirit was the bridal car, the canopy thereof was heaven: A Two radiant oxen formed tho team when Surya came uuto her lord.

verses.sa:
ऋक्सामाभ्यामभिहितौ गावौ ते सामनावैताम्।
श्रोत्रे ते चक्रे आस्तां दिवि पन्थाश्चराचरः॥
verses.tr: ṛksāmābhyāmabhihitau gāvau te sāmanāvaitām śrotre te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāścarācaraḥ
verses.en: Steadily went the steers upheld by holy verse and song of praise. Thy chariot-wheels were listening ears: thy path was tremulous in the sky.

verses.sa:
शुची ते चक्रे यात्या व्यानो अक्ष आहतः ।
अनो मनस्मयं सूर्यारोहत् प्रयती पतिम्॥
verses.tr: śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ ano manasmayaṃ sūryārohat prayatī patim
verses.en: Pure, as thou wentest, were thy wheels, breath was the axle piercing them. Surya advancing to her lord rode on the chariot of her heart.

verses.sa:
सूर्याया वहतुः प्रागात् सविता यमवासृजत्।
मघासु हन्यन्ते गावः फल्गुनीषु व्युऽह्यते॥
verses.tr: sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgāt savitā yamavāsṛjat maghāsu hanyante gāvaḥ phalgunīṣu vyu'hyate
verses.en: The bridal pomp of Surya, which Savitar started, moved along. In Magha days are oxen slain, in Phalguuis they wed the bride.

verses.sa:
यदश्विना पृच्छमानावयातं त्रिचक्रेण वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
क्वैकं चक्रं वामासीत् क्वऽदेष्ट्राय तस्थथुः॥
verses.tr: yadaśvinā pṛcchamānāvayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vāmāsīt kva'deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ
verses.en: When on your three-wheeled chariot, O ye Asvins, ye came as suitors unto Surya's bridal, Where was one chariot-wheel of yours? Where stood ye for the sire's command?

verses.sa:
यदयातं शुभस्पती वरेयं सूर्यामुप ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तद् वामजानन् पुत्रः पितरमवृणीत पूषा॥
verses.tr: yadayātaṃ śubhaspatī vareyaṃ sūryāmupa viśve devā anu tad vāmajānan putraḥ pitaramavṛṇīta pūṣā
verses.en: Twin Lords of Lustre, at the time when ye to Surya's wooing came, Then all the Gods agreed to your proposal. Pushan as son elected you as father,

verses.sa:
द्वे ते चक्रे सूर्ये ब्रह्माण ऋतुथा विदुः ।
अथैकं चक्रं यद् गुहा तदद्धातय इद् विदुः॥
verses.tr: dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ athaikaṃ cakraṃ yad guhā tadaddhātaya id viduḥ
verses.en: Two wheels of thine the Brahmans know, Surya! according to their times, That which is hidden only those who know the highest truths have learned.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं यजामहे सुबन्धुं पतिवेदनम्।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनात् प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः॥
verses.tr: aryamaṇaṃ yajāmahe subandhuṃ pativedanam urvārukamiva bandhanāt preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ
verses.en: Worship we pay to Aryaman, finder of husbands, kindly friend, As from its stalk a cucumber, from here I loose thee, not from there,

verses.sa:
प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः सुबद्धाममुतस्करम्।
यथेयमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रा सुभगासति॥
verses.tr: preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskaram yatheyamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati
verses.en: Hence and not thence I send her free, I make her softly fettered there, That, bounteous Indra! she may live blest in her fortune and her sons.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद् येन त्वाबध्नात् सविता सुशेवाः ।
ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके स्योनं ते अस्तु सहसंभलायै॥
verses.tr: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevāḥ ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke syonaṃ te astu sahasaṃbhalāyai
verses.en: Now from the noose of Varuna I free thee, wherewith the blessed Savitar hath bound thee. May bliss be thine together with thy wooer in Order's dwelling, in the world of virtue.

verses.sa:
भगस्त्वेतो नयतु हस्तगृह्याश्विना त्वा प्र वहतां रथेन ।
गृहान् गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो वशिनी त्वं विदथमा वदासि॥
verses.tr: bhagastveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinā tvā pra vahatāṃ rathena gṛhān gaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathamā vadāsi
verses.en: Let Bhaga take thy hand and hence conduct thee: let the two Asvins on their car transport thee. Go to the house to be the household's mistress, and speak as lady to thy gathered people.

verses.sa:
इह प्रियं प्रजायै ते समृध्यतामस्मिन् गृहे गार्हपत्याय जागृहि ।
एना पत्या तन्वं१ सं स्पृशस्वाथ जिर्विर्विदथमा वदासि॥
verses.tr: iha priyaṃ prajāyai te samṛdhyatāmasmin gṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi enā patyā tanvaṃ1 saṃ spṛśasvātha jirvirvidathamā vadāsi
verses.en: Happy be thou and prosper with thy children here: be vigilant to rule thy household in this home. Closely unite thy body with this man thy lord, So shalt thou, full of years, address thy company,

verses.sa:
इहैव स्तं मा वि यौष्टं विश्वमायुर्व्यऽश्नुतम्।
क्रीडन्तौ पुत्रैर्नप्तृभिर्मोदमानौ स्वस्तकौ॥
verses.tr: ihaiva staṃ mā vi yauṣṭaṃ viśvamāyurvya'śnutam krīḍantau putrairnaptṛbhirmodamānau svastakau
verses.en: Be not divided; dwell ye here; reach the full time of human life, With sons and grandsons sport and play, rejoicing in your happy home.

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परि यातोऽर्णवम्।
विश्वान्यो भुवना विचष्ट ऋतूंरन्यो विदधज्जायसे नवः॥
verses.tr: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto'rṇavam viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭa ṛtūṃranyo vidadhajjāyase navaḥ
verses.en: Moving by magic power from east to westward, these children twain go sporting round the ocean. The one beholds all creatures: thou, the other, art born anew, duly arranging seasons,

verses.sa:
नवोनवो भवसि जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेष्यग्रम्।
भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधास्यायन् प्र चन्द्रमस्तिरसे दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: navonavo bhavasi jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmeṣyagram bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhāsyāyan pra candramastirase dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: Thou, born afresh, art new and new for ever; ensign of days, before the Dawns thou goest. Coming, thou orderest for Gods their portion. Thou lengthenest, Moon, the days of our existence.

verses.sa:
परा देहि शामुल्यं ब्रह्मभ्यो वि भजा वसु ।
कृत्यैषा पद्वती भूत्वा जाया विशते पतिम्॥
verses.tr: parā dehi śāmulyaṃ brahmabhyo vi bhajā vasu kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvā jāyā viśate patim
verses.en: Give thou the woollen robe away: deal treasure to the Brahman- priests. This Witchery hath got her feet: the wife attendeth on her lord.

verses.sa:
नीललोहितं भवति कृत्यासक्तिर्व्यऽज्यते ।
एधन्ते अस्या ज्ञातयः पतिर्बन्धेषु बध्यते॥
verses.tr: nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyāsaktirvya'jyate edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patirbandheṣu badhyate
verses.en: It turneth dusky-red: the witch who clingeth close is driven off, Well thrive the kinsmen of this bride: the husband is bound fast in bonds.

verses.sa:
अश्लीला तनूर्भवति रुशती पापयामुया।
पतिर्यद् वध्वो३वाससः स्वमङ्गमभ्यूर्णुते॥
verses.tr: aślīlā tanūrbhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā patiryad vadhvo3vāsasaḥ svamaṅgamabhyūrṇute
verses.en: Unlovely is his body when it glistens with that wicked fiend, What time the husband wraps about his limbs the garment of his wife.

verses.sa:
आशसनं विशसनमथो अधिविकर्तनम्।
सूर्यायाः पश्य रूपाणि तानि ब्रह्मोत शुम्भति॥
verses.tr: āśasanaṃ viśasanamatho adhivikartanam sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmota śumbhati
verses.en: The butchering, the cutting-up, the severing of limb and joint,—Behold the forms which Surya wears: yet these the Brahman purifies.

verses.sa:
तृष्टमेतत् कटुकमपाष्ठवद् विषवन्नैतदत्तवे ।
सूर्यां यो ब्रह्मा वेद स इद् वाधूयमर्हति॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṭametat kaṭukamapāṣṭhavad viṣavannaitadattave sūryāṃ yo brahmā veda sa id vādhūyamarhati
verses.en: Pungent is this, bitter is this, filled as it were with arrow barbs, empoisoned and not fit for use, The Brahman who knows Surya well deserves the garment of the bride,

verses.sa:
स इत् तत् स्योनं हरति ब्रह्मा वासः सुमङ्गलम्।
प्रायश्चित्तिं यो अध्येति येन जाया न रिष्यति॥
verses.tr: sa it tat syonaṃ harati brahmā vāsaḥ sumaṅgalam prāyaścittiṃ yo adhyeti yena jāyā na riṣyati
verses.en: The Brahman takes away the robe asa fair thing that brings good luck, He knows the expiating rite whereby the wife is kept unharmed.

verses.sa:
युवं भगं सं भरतं समृद्धमृतं वदन्तावृतोद्येषु ।
ब्रह्मणस्पते पतिमस्यै रोचय चारु संभलो वदतु वाचमेताम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ bhagaṃ saṃ bharataṃ samṛddhamṛtaṃ vadantāvṛtodyeṣu brahmaṇaspate patimasyai rocaya cāru saṃbhalo vadatu vācametām
verses.en: Prepare, ye twain, happy and prosperous fortune, speaking the truth in faithful utterances. Dear unto her, Brihaspati, make the husband, and pleasant be these words the wooer speaketh.

verses.sa:
इहेदसाथ न परो गमाथेमं गावः प्रजया वर्धयाथ ।
शुभं यतीरुस्रियाः सोमवर्चसो विश्वे देवाः क्रन्निह वो मनांसि॥
verses.tr: ihedasātha na paro gamāthemaṃ gāvaḥ prajayā vardhayātha śubhaṃ yatīrusriyāḥ somavarcaso viśve devāḥ kranniha vo manāṃsi
verses.en: Remain ye even here and go no farther: strengthen this man, ye Cows, with plenteous offspring, May Dawns that come for glory, bright with Soma, here may all Gods fix and enchant your spirits,

verses.sa:
इमं गावः प्रजया सं विशाथायं देवानां न मिनाति भागम्।
अस्मै वः पूषा मरुतश्च सर्वे अस्मै वो धाता सविता सुवाति॥
verses.tr: imaṃ gāvaḥ prajayā saṃ viśāthāyaṃ devānāṃ na mināti bhāgam asmai vaḥ pūṣā marutaśca sarve asmai vo dhātā savitā suvāti
verses.en: Come, O ye Cows, with offspring dwell around him: he doth not stint the Gods' alloted portion. To him, your friend, may Pushan, all the Maruts, to him may Dhatar, Savitar send vigour, Mp meet wi Create cs

verses.sa:
अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्थनो येभिः सखायो यन्ति नो वरेयम्।
सं भगेन समर्यम्णा सं धाता सृजतु वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthano yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam saṃ bhagena samaryamṇā saṃ dhātā sṛjatu varcasā
verses.en: Straight in direction be the paths, and thornless, whereby our fellows travel to the wooing. With Bhaga and with Aryaman Dhatar endue the pair with strength!

verses.sa:
यच्च वर्चो अक्षेषु सुरायां च यदाहितम्।
यद् गोष्वश्विना वर्चस्तेनेमां वर्चसावतम्॥
verses.tr: yacca varco akṣeṣu surāyāṃ ca yadāhitam yad goṣvaśvinā varcastenemāṃ varcasāvatam
verses.en: Whatever lustre is in dice, whatever lustre is in wine, Whatever lustre is in cows, Asvins, endue this dame therewith.

verses.sa:
ये न महानघ्न्या जघनमश्विना येन वा सुरा ।
येनाक्षा अभ्यषिच्यन्त तेनेमां वर्चसावतम्॥
verses.tr: ye na mahānaghnyā jaghanamaśvinā yena vā surā yenākṣā abhyaṣicyanta tenemāṃ varcasāvatam
verses.en: With all the sheen that balmeth wine, or thigh of female paramour, With all the sheen that balmeth dice, even with this adorn the dame,

verses.sa:
यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्व१न्तर्यं विप्रास ईडते अध्वरेषु ।
अपां नपान्मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्याऽवान्॥
verses.tr: yo anidhmo dīdayadapsva1ntaryaṃ viprāsa īḍate adhvareṣu apāṃ napānmadhumatīrapo dā yābhirindro vāvṛdhe vīryā'vān
verses.en: He who in water shines unfed with fuel, whom sages. worship in their sacrifices, May he, the Waters' Child, send us sweet waters, those that enhanced the power of mighty Indra,

verses.sa:
इदमहं रुशन्तं ग्राभं तनूदूषिमपोहामि ।
यो भद्रो रोचनस्तमुदचामि॥
verses.tr: idamahaṃ ruśantaṃ grābhaṃ tanūdūṣimapohāmi yo bhadro rocanastamudacāmi
verses.en: I cast away a handful here, hurtful, injurious to-health. I lift another handful up, sparkling and bringing happiness.

verses.sa:
आस्यै ब्राह्मणाः स्नपनीर्हरन्त्ववीरघ्नीरुदजन्त्वापः ।
अर्यम्णो अग्निं पर्येतु पूषन् प्रतीक्षन्ते श्वशुरो देवरश्च॥
verses.tr: āsyai brāhmaṇāḥ snapanīrharantvavīraghnīrudajantvāpaḥ aryamṇo agniṃ paryetu pūṣan pratīkṣante śvaśuro devaraśca
verses.en: Hither let Brahmans bring her bathing water; let them draw such as guards the lives of heroes, Aryaman's fire let her encircle, Pushan! Fathers-in-law stand, with their sons, expectant,

verses.sa:
शं ते हिरण्यं शमु सन्त्वापः शं मेथिर्भवतु शं युगस्य तर्द्म ।
शं त आपः शतपवित्रा भवन्तु शमु पत्या तन्वं१ सं स्पृशस्व॥
verses.tr: śaṃ te hiraṇyaṃ śamu santvāpaḥ śaṃ methirbhavatu śaṃ yugasya tardma śaṃ ta āpaḥ śatapavitrā bhavantu śamu patyā tanvaṃ1 saṃ spṛśasva
verses.en: Blest be the gold to thee, and blest the water, blest the yoke's opening, and blest the pillar. Biest be the waters with their hundred cleansings: blest be thy body's union with thy husband,

verses.sa:
खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो ।
अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्वाकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम्॥
verses.tr: khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato apālāmindra triṣpūtvākṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam
verses.en: Cleansing Apala, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sun-bright skin to her Drawn, Satakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke,

verses.sa:
आशासाना सौमनसं प्रजां सौभाग्यं रयिम्।
पत्युरनुव्रता भूत्वा सं नह्यस्वामृताय कम्॥
verses.tr: āśāsānā saumanasaṃ prajāṃ saubhāgyaṃ rayim patyuranuvratā bhūtvā saṃ nahyasvāmṛtāya kam
verses.en: Saying thy prayer for cheerfulness, children, prosperity, and wealth, Devoted to thy husband, gird thyself for immortality.

verses.sa:
यथा सिन्धुर्नदीनां साम्राज्यं सुषुवे वृषा ।
एवा त्वं सम्राज्ञ्येधि पत्युरस्तं परेत्य॥
verses.tr: yathā sindhurnadīnāṃ sāmrājyaṃ suṣuve vṛṣā evā tvaṃ samrājñyedhi patyurastaṃ paretya
verses.en: As vigorous Sindhu won himself imperial lordship of the streams, So be imperial queen when thou hast come within thy husband's home.

verses.sa:
सम्राज्ञ्येधि श्वशुरेषु सम्राज्ञ्युत देवृषु ।
ननान्दुः सम्राज्ञ्येधि सम्राज्ञ्युत श्वश्र्वाः॥
verses.tr: samrājñyedhi śvaśureṣu samrājñyuta devṛṣu nanānduḥ samrājñyedhi samrājñyuta śvaśrvāḥ
verses.en: Over thy husband's fathers and his brothers be imperial queen, Over thy husband's sister and his mother bear supreme control.

verses.sa:
या अकृन्तन्नवयन् याश्च तत्निरे या देवीरन्तां अभितोऽददन्त ।
तास्त्वा जरसे सं व्ययन्त्वायुष्मतीदं परि धत्स्व वासः॥
verses.tr: yā akṛntannavayan yāśca tatnire yā devīrantāṃ abhito'dadanta tāstvā jarase saṃ vyayantvāyuṣmatīdaṃ pari dhatsva vāsaḥ
verses.en: They who heve spun, and woven, and extended, Goddesses who have drawn the ends together, May they invest thee full long existence. Heiress of lengthened life, endue this garment.

verses.sa:
जीवं रुदन्ति वि नयन्त्यध्वरं दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं दीध्युर्नरः ।
वामं पितृभ्यो य इदं समीरिरे मयः पतिभ्यो जनये परिष्वजे॥
verses.tr: jīvaṃ rudanti vi nayantyadhvaraṃ dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ dīdhyurnaraḥ vāmaṃ pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ samīrire mayaḥ patibhyo janaye pariṣvaje
verses.en: They mourn the living, they arrange the sacred rite: the men have set their thoughts upon a distant cast; They who have brought the Fathers this delightful gift, when wives allowed their lords the joy of their embrace.

verses.sa:
स्योनं ध्रुवं प्रजायै धारयामि तेऽश्मानं देव्याः पृथिव्या उपस्थे ।
तमा तिष्ठानुमाद्या सुवर्चा दीर्घं त आयुः सविता कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: syonaṃ dhruvaṃ prajāyai dhārayāmi te'śmānaṃ devyāḥ pṛthivyā upasthe tamā tiṣṭhānumādyā suvarcā dīrghaṃ ta āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
verses.en: I place upon the lap of Earth the Goddess, a firm auspicious stone to bring thee children. Stand on it, thou, greeted with joy, respl endent: a long long life may Savitar vouchsafe thee.

verses.sa:
ये नाग्निरस्या भूम्या हस्तं जग्राह दक्षिणम्।
तेन गृह्णामि ते हस्तं मा व्यथिष्ठा मया सह प्रजया च धनेन च॥
verses.tr: ye nāgnirasyā bhūmyā hastaṃ jagrāha dakṣiṇam tena gṛhṇāmi te hastaṃ mā vyathiṣṭhā mayā saha prajayā ca dhanena ca
verses.en: As Agni in the olden time took the right hand of this our Earth, Even so I take and hold thy hand: be not disquieted, with me, with children and with store of wealth,

verses.sa:
देवस्ते सविता हस्तं गृह्णातु सोमो राजा सुप्रजसं कृणोतु ।
अग्निः सुभगां जतवेदाः पत्ये पत्नीं जरदष्टिं कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: devaste savitā hastaṃ gṛhṇātu somo rājā suprajasaṃ kṛṇotu agniḥ subhagāṃ jatavedāḥ patye patnīṃ jaradaṣṭiṃ kṛṇotu
verses.en: God Savitar shall take thy hand, and Soma the King shall make thee rich in goodly offspring. Let Agni, Lord Omniscient, make thee happy, till old old age a wife unto thy husband,

verses.sa:
गृह्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः ।
भगो अर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर्मह्यं त्वादुर्गार्हपत्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: gṛhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhirmahyaṃ tvādurgārhapatyāya devāḥ
verses.en: I take thy hand in mine for happy fortune that thou mayst reach old age with me thy consort. Gods, Aryaman, Bhaga, Savitar, Purandhi, have given thee to be my household's mistress,

verses.sa:
भगस्ते हस्तमग्रहीत् सविता हस्तमग्रहीत्।
पत्नी त्वमसि धर्मणाहं गृहपतिस्तव॥
verses.tr: bhagaste hastamagrahīt savitā hastamagrahīt patnī tvamasi dharmaṇāhaṃ gṛhapatistava
verses.en: Bhaga and Savitar the God have clasped that hand of thine in theirs. By rule and law thou art my wife: the master of thy house am I,

verses.sa:
ममेयमस्तु पोष्या मह्यं त्वादाद् बृहस्पतिः ।
मया पत्या प्रजावति सं जीव शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: mameyamastu poṣyā mahyaṃ tvādād bṛhaspatiḥ mayā patyā prajāvati saṃ jīva śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: Be it my care to cherish her: Brihaspati hath made thee mine, A hundred autumns live with me thy husband, mother of my sons! i

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा वासो व्यदधाच्छुभे कं बृहस्पतेः प्रशिषा कवीनाम्।
तेनेमां नारीं सविता भगश्च सूर्यामिव परि धत्तां प्रजया॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā vāso vyadadhācchubhe kaṃ bṛhaspateḥ praśiṣā kavīnām tenemāṃ nārīṃ savitā bhagaśca sūryāmiva pari dhattāṃ prajayā
verses.en: Tvashtar, by order of the holy sages, hath laid on her Brihaspati's robe for glory. By means of this let Savitar and Bhaga surround this dame, like Surya, with her children.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी द्यावापृथिवी मातरिश्वा मित्रावरुणा भगो अश्विनोभा।
बृहस्पतिर्मरुतो ब्रह्म सोम इमां नारीं प्रजया वर्धयन्तु॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī mātariśvā mitrāvaruṇā bhago aśvinobhā bṛhaspatirmaruto brahma soma imāṃ nārīṃ prajayā vardhayantu
verses.en: May Indra-agni, Heaven-earth, Matarisvan, may Mitra-varuna, Bhaga, both the Asvins, Brihaspati, the host of Maruts, Brahma, and Soma magnify this dame with offspring,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः प्रथमः सूर्यायाः शीर्षे केशां अकल्पयत्।
तेनेमामश्विना नारीं पत्ये सं शोभयामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaḥ sūryāyāḥ śīrṣe keśāṃ akalpayat tenemāmaśvinā nārīṃ patye saṃ śobhayāmasi
verses.en: It was Brihaspati who first arranged the hair on Surya's head, And therefore, O ye Asvins, we adorn this woman for her lord,

verses.sa:
इदं तद् रूपं यदवस्त योषा जायां जिज्ञासे मनसा चरन्तीम्।
तामन्वर्तिष्ये सखिभिर्नवग्वैः क इमान् विद्वान् वि चचर्त पाशान्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ tad rūpaṃ yadavasta yoṣā jāyāṃ jijñāse manasā carantīm tāmanvartiṣye sakhibhirnavagvaiḥ ka imān vidvān vi cacarta pāśān
verses.en: This lovely form the maiden wears in spirit I long. to look on as my wife approaching, Her will I follow with my -nine companions. Who is the sage that loosed the bonds that held her?

verses.sa:
अहं वि ष्यामि मयि रूपमस्या वेददित् पश्यन् मनसः कुलायम्।
न स्तेयमद्मि मनसोदमुच्ये स्वयं श्रथ्नानो वरुणस्य पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ vi ṣyāmi mayi rūpamasyā vedadit paśyan manasaḥ kulāyam na steyamadmi manasodamucye svayaṃ śrathnāno varuṇasya pāśān
verses.en: I free her: he who sees, within my bosom, my heart's nest knows how her lair form hath struck me, I taste no stolen food: myself untying Varuna's nooses I am freed in spirit,

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद् येन त्वाबध्नात् सविता सुशेवाः ।
उरुं लोकं सुगमत्र पन्थां कृणोमि तुभ्यं सहपत्न्यै वधु॥
verses.tr: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevāḥ uruṃ lokaṃ sugamatra panthāṃ kṛṇomi tubhyaṃ sahapatnyai vadhu
verses.en: Now from the bond of Varuna I loose thee, wherein the blessed Savitar hath bound thee. l O bride, I give thee here beside thy husband fair space and room and pleasant paths to travel,

verses.sa:
उद्यच्छध्वमप रक्षो हनाथेमं नारीं सुकृते दधात ।
धाता विपश्चित् पतिमस्यै विवेद भगो राजा पुर एतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: udyacchadhvamapa rakṣo hanāthemaṃ nārīṃ sukṛte dadhāta dhātā vipaścit patimasyai viveda bhago rājā pura etu prajānan
verses.en: Lift up your weapons. Drive away the demons, Transport this woman to the world of virtue. Dhatar, most wise, hath found for her a husband. Let him who knows, King Bhaga, go before her.

verses.sa:
भगस्ततक्ष चतुरः पादान् भगस्ततक्ष चत्वार्युष्पलानि ।
त्वष्टा पिपेश मध्यतोऽनु वर्ध्रान्त्सा नो अस्तु सुमङ्गली॥
verses.tr: bhagastatakṣa caturaḥ pādān bhagastatakṣa catvāryuṣpalāni tvaṣṭā pipeśa madhyato'nu vardhrāntsā no astu sumaṅgalī
verses.en: Bhaga hath formed the four legs of the litter, wrought the four pieces that compose the framework. Tvashtar hath decked the straps that go across it, May it be blest, and bring us happy fortune,

verses.sa:
सुकिंशुकं वहतुं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुवृतं सुचक्रम्।
आ रोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य लोकं स्योनं पतिभ्यो वहतुं कृणु त्वम्॥
verses.tr: sukiṃśukaṃ vahatuṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram ā roha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonaṃ patibhyo vahatuṃ kṛṇu tvam
verses.en: Mount this, all-hued, gold-tinted, strong-wheeled, fashioned of Kinsuka, this chariot lightly rolling, Bound for the world of life immortal, Surya! Make for thy lord a happy bride's procession,

verses.sa:
अभ्रातृघ्नीं वरुणापशुघ्नीं बृहस्पते ।
इन्द्रापतिघ्नीं पुत्रिणीमास्मभ्यं सवितर्वह॥
verses.tr: abhrātṛghnīṃ varuṇāpaśughnīṃ bṛhaspate indrāpatighnīṃ putriṇīmāsmabhyaṃ savitarvaha
verses.en: To us, O Varuna, bring her, kind to brothers; bring her, Brihaspati, gentle to the cattle, Bring her, O Indra, gentle to her husband: bring her to us, O Savitar, blest with children.

verses.sa:
मा हिंसिष्टं कुमार्यं१ स्थूणे देवकृते पथि।
शालाया देव्या द्वारं स्योनं कृण्मो वधूपथम्॥
verses.tr: mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ kumāryaṃ1 sthūṇe devakṛte pathi śālāyā devyā dvāraṃ syonaṃ kṛṇmo vadhūpatham
verses.en: Hurt not "the girl, ye Pillans twain upon the path which Gods have made. The portal of the heavenly home we make the bride's auspicious road,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मापरं युज्यतां ब्रह्म पूर्वं ब्रह्मान्ततो मध्यतो ब्रह्म सर्वतः ।
अनाव्याधां देवपुरां प्रपद्य शिवा स्योना पतिलोके वि राज॥
verses.tr: brahmāparaṃ yujyatāṃ brahma pūrvaṃ brahmāntato madhyato brahma sarvataḥ anāvyādhāṃ devapurāṃ prapadya śivā syonā patiloke vi rāja
verses.en: Let prayer be offered up before and after, prayer in the middle, lastly, all around her. Reaching the Gods' inviolable castle shine in thy lord's world gentle and auspicious,

sections.label: On the Bridal of Surya, and marriage ceremonies in general, continued
sections.name: Book 14, hymn 2

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यवहन्त्सूर्यां वहतुना सह।
स नः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह॥
verses.tr: tubhyamagre paryavahantsūryāṃ vahatunā saha sa naḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha
verses.en: For thee with bridal train they first escorted Surya to her home, Give to the husband in return, Agni, the wife with future sons,

verses.sa:
पुनः पत्नीमग्निरदादायुषा सह वर्चसा ।
दीर्घायुरस्या यः पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: punaḥ patnīmagniradādāyuṣā saha varcasā dīrghāyurasyā yaḥ patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: Agni hath given the bride again with splendour and a lengthened life. Long-lived be he who is her lord: a hundred autumns let him live,

verses.sa:
सोमस्य जाया प्रथमं गन्धर्वस्तेऽपरः पतिः ।
तृतीयो अग्निष्टे पतिस्तुरीयस्ते मनुष्यजाः॥
verses.tr: somasya jāyā prathamaṃ gandharvaste'paraḥ patiḥ tṛtīyo agniṣṭe patisturīyaste manuṣyajāḥ
verses.en: She was the wife of Soma first: next the Gandharva was thy lord. Agni was thy third husband: now one born of woman is thy fourth.

verses.sa:
सोमो ददद् गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो दददग्नये ।
रयिं च पुत्रांस्चादादग्निर्मह्यमथो इमाम्॥
verses.tr: somo dadad gandharvāya gandharvo dadadagnaye rayiṃ ca putrāṃscādādagnirmahyamatho imām
verses.en: Soma to the Gandharva, and to Agni the Gandharva gave. Now, Agni hath bestowed on me riches and sons and this my bride.

verses.sa:
आ वामगन्त्सुमतिर्वाजिनीवसू न्यश्विना हृत्सु कामा अरंसत ।
अभूतं गोपा मिथुना शुभस्पती प्रिया अर्यम्णो दुर्यां अशीमहि॥
verses.tr: ā vāmagantsumatirvājinīvasū nyaśvinā hṛtsu kāmā araṃsata abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhaspatī priyā aryamṇo duryāṃ aśīmahi
verses.en: Your favouring grace hath come, ye who are rich in spoil! Asvins, our longings are stored up within your hearts, Ye, Lords of Splendour have become our twofold guard: may we as dear friends reach the dwelling 'of the friend.

verses.sa:
सा मन्दसाना मनसा शिवेन रयिं धेहि सर्ववीरं वचस्यऽम्।
सुगं तीर्थं सुप्रपाणं शुभस्पती स्थाणुं पथिष्ठामप दुर्मतिं हतम्॥
verses.tr: sā mandasānā manasā śivena rayiṃ dhehi sarvavīraṃ vacasya'm sugaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ pathiṣṭhāmapa durmatiṃ hatam
verses.en: Thou, Dame, rejoicing, take with kindly spirit wealth worthy to be famed, with all thy heroes, Give, Lords of Light. a fair ford, good to drink at: remove the spiteful stump that blocks the pathway.

verses.sa:
या ओषधयो या नद्यो३ यानि क्षेत्राणि या वना ।
तास्त्वा वधु प्रजावतीं पत्ये रक्षन्तु रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhayo yā nadyo3 yāni kṣetrāṇi yā vanā tāstvā vadhu prajāvatīṃ patye rakṣantu rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: May all the Rivers, all the Plants, may all the Forests, all the Fields, O Bride, protect thee from the fiend, guard his song mother for her lord,

verses.sa:
एमं पन्थामरुक्षाम सुगं स्वस्तिवाहनम्।
यस्मिन् वीरो न रिष्यत्यन्येषां विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: emaṃ panthāmarukṣāma sugaṃ svastivāhanam yasmin vīro na riṣyatyanyeṣāṃ vindate vasu
verses.en: Our feet are on this pleasant path, easy to travel, bringing bliss, Whereon no hero suffers harm, which wins the wealth of other men.

verses.sa:
इदं सु मे नरः शृणुत ययाशिषा दंपती वाममश्नुतः ।
ये गन्धर्वा अप्सरसश्च देवीरेषु वानस्पत्येषु येऽधि तस्थुः ।
स्योनास्ते अस्यै वध्वै भवन्तु मा हिंसिषुर्वहतुमुह्यमानम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ su me naraḥ śṛṇuta yayāśiṣā daṃpatī vāmamaśnutaḥ ye gandharvā apsarasaśca devīreṣu vānaspatyeṣu ye'dhi tasthuḥ syonāste asyai vadhvai bhavantu mā hiṃsiṣurvahatumuhyamānam
verses.en: Hear these my words, ye men, the benediction through which the wedded pair have found high fortune. May the divine Apsarases, Gandharvas, all they who are these fruitful trees' protectors, Regard this bride with their auspicious, favour, nor harm the nuptial pomp as it advances,

verses.sa:
ये वध्वश्चन्द्रं वहतुं यक्ष्मा यन्ति जनाँ अनु ।
पुनस्तान् यज्ञिया देवा नयन्तु यत आगताः॥
verses.tr: ye vadhvaścandraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janāṃ anu punastān yajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ
verses.en: Consumptions, which, through various folk, attack the bride's resplendent train, These let the holy Gods again bear to the place from which thy sprang.

verses.sa:
मा विदन् परिपन्थिनो य आसीदन्ति दंपती ।
सुगेन दुर्गमतीतामप द्रान्त्वरातयः॥
verses.tr: mā vidan paripanthino ya āsīdanti daṃpatī sugena durgamatītāmapa drāntvarātayaḥ
verses.en: Let not the highway thieves' who lie in ambush find the wedded pair. Let wicked men's malignities go elsewhere by an easy path,

verses.sa:
सं काशयामि वहतुं ब्रह्मणा गृहैरघोरेण चक्षुषा मित्रियेण ।
पर्याणद्धं विश्वरूपं यदस्ति स्योनं पतिभ्यः सविता तत् कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: saṃ kāśayāmi vahatuṃ brahmaṇā gṛhairaghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa paryāṇaddhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yadasti syonaṃ patibhyaḥ savitā tat kṛṇotu
verses.en: I look upon the house and brides procession with prayer and with the gentle eye of friendship. All that is covered there in perfect beauty may Savitar make pleasant to the husband.

verses.sa:
शिवा नारीयमस्तमागन्निमं धाता लोकमस्यै दिदेश ।
तामर्यमा भगो अश्विनोभा प्रजापतिः प्रजया वर्धयन्तु॥
verses.tr: śivā nārīyamastamāgannimaṃ dhātā lokamasyai dideśa tāmaryamā bhago aśvinobhā prajāpatiḥ prajayā vardhayantu
verses.en: She hath come home, this dame come home to bless us: this her appointed world hath Dhatar shown her. So may Prajapati, and both the Asvins, Aryaman, Bhaga gladden her with offispring.

verses.sa:
आत्मन्वत्युर्वरा नारीयमागन् तस्यां नरो वपत बीजमस्याम्।
सा वः प्रजां जनयद् वक्षणाभ्यो बिभ्रती दुग्धमृषभस्य रेतः॥
verses.tr: ātmanvatyurvarā nārīyamāgan tasyāṃ naro vapata bījamasyām sā vaḥ prajāṃ janayad vakṣaṇābhyo bibhratī dugdhamṛṣabhasya retaḥ
verses.en: This dame hath come, an animated corn-field: there sow, thou man, the seed of future harvest. She from her teeming side shall bear thee children, and feed them from the fountain of her bosom.

verses.sa:
प्रति तिष्ठ विराडसि विष्णुरिवेह सरस्वति ।
सिनीवालि प्र जायतां भगस्य सुमतावसत्॥
verses.tr: prati tiṣṭha virāḍasi viṣṇuriveha sarasvati sinīvāli pra jāyatāṃ bhagasya sumatāvasat
verses.en: Take thou thy stand, a Queen art thou, like Vishnu here, Sarasvati! O Sinivali, let her bear children, and live qu iu Bhaga's grace.

verses.sa:
उद् व ऊर्मिः शम्या हन्त्वापो योक्त्राणि मुञ्चत ।
मादुष्कृतौ व्येनसावघ्न्यावशुनमारताम्॥
verses.tr: ud va ūrmiḥ śamyā hantvāpo yoktrāṇi muñcata māduṣkṛtau vyenasāvaghnyāvaśunamāratām
verses.en: So let your wave bear up the pins, and ye, O Waters, spare the thongs; And never may the holy pair, sinless and innocent, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अघोरचक्षुरपतिघ्नी स्योना शग्मा सुशेवा सुयमा गृहेभ्यः ।
वीरसूर्देवकामा सं त्वयैधिषीमहि सुमनस्यमाना॥
verses.tr: aghoracakṣurapatighnī syonā śagmā suśevā suyamā gṛhebhyaḥ vīrasūrdevakāmā saṃ tvayaidhiṣīmahi sumanasyamānā
verses.en: Not evil-syed no slayer of thy husband, be strong wild, kind, and gentle to thy household. Mother of heroes, love thy husband's father: be happy; and through thee may we too prosper.

verses.sa:
अदेवृघ्न्यपतिघ्नीहैधि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुयमा सुवर्चाः ।
प्रजावती वीरसूर्देवकामा स्योनेममग्निं गार्हपत्यं सपर्य॥
verses.tr: adevṛghnyapatighnīhaidhi śivā paśubhyaḥ suyamā suvarcāḥ prajāvatī vīrasūrdevakāmā syonemamagniṃ gārhapatyaṃ saparya
verses.en: No slayer of thy husband or his father, gentle and bright, bring blessing on the cattle, Loving thy husband's father, bring forth heroes. Tend well this household fire: be soft and pleasant,

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठेतः किमिच्छन्तीदमागा अहं त्वेडे अभिभूः स्वाद् गृहात्।
शून्यैषी निरृते याजगन्थोत्तिष्ठाराते प्र पत मेह रंस्थाः॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhetaḥ kimicchantīdamāgā ahaṃ tveḍe abhibhūḥ svād gṛhāt śūnyaiṣī nirṛte yājaganthottiṣṭhārāte pra pata meha raṃsthāḥ
verses.en: Up and begone! What wish hath brought thee hither from thine own house? Thy mightier, I conjure thee. Vain is the hope, O Nirriti, that brought thee, Fly. off, Malignity; stay here no longer,

verses.sa:
यदा गार्हपत्यमसपर्यैत् पूर्वमग्निं वधूरियम्।
अधा सरस्वत्यै नारि पितृभ्यश्च नमस्कुरु॥
verses.tr: yadā gārhapatyamasaparyait pūrvamagniṃ vadhūriyam adhā sarasvatyai nāri pitṛbhyaśca namaskuru
verses.en: As first of all this woman hath adored the sacred household fire, So do thou, Dame, pay homage to the Fathers and Sarasvati,

verses.sa:
शर्म वर्मैतदा हरास्यै नार्या उपस्तिरे ।
सिनीवालि प्र जायतां भगस्य सुमतावसत्॥
verses.tr: śarma varmaitadā harāsyai nāryā upastire sinīvāli pra jāyatāṃ bhagasya sumatāvasat
verses.en: Take thou this wrapper as a screen, to be a covering for the bride, -O Sinivali, let her bear children, and live in Bhaga's race.

verses.sa:
यं बल्बजं न्यस्यथ चर्म चोपस्तृणीथन ।
तदा रोहतु सुप्रजा या कन्या विन्दते पतिम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ balbajaṃ nyasyatha carma copastṛṇīthana tadā rohatu suprajā yā kanyā vindate patim
verses.en: Let her who shall be blest with sons, the maid who finds a husband, step Upon the rough grass that ye spread and on the skin ye lay beneath.

verses.sa:
उप स्तृणीहि बल्बजमधि चर्मणि रोहिते ।
तत्रोपविश्य सुप्रजा इममग्निं सपर्यतु॥
verses.tr: upa stṛṇīhi balbajamadhi carmaṇi rohite tatropaviśya suprajā imamagniṃ saparyatu
verses.en: Over the ruddy-coloured skin strew thou the grass, the Balbuja, Let her, the mother of good sons, sit there and serve this Agni here.

verses.sa:
आ रोह चर्मोप सीदाग्निमेष देवो हन्ति रक्षांसि सर्वा ।
इह प्रजां जनय पत्ये अस्मै सुज्यैष्ठ्यो भवत् पुत्रस्त एषः॥
verses.tr: ā roha carmopa sīdāgnimeṣa devo hanti rakṣāṃsi sarvā iha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai sujyaiṣṭhyo bhavat putrasta eṣaḥ
verses.en: Step on the skin and wait upon this Agni: he is the God who drives away all demons, Here bear thou children to this man thy husband: let this thy boy be happy in his birthight.

verses.sa:
वि तिष्ठन्तां मातुरस्या उपस्थान्नानारूपाः पशवो जायमानाः ।
सुमङ्गल्युप सीदेममग्निं संपत्नी प्रति भूषेह देवान्॥
verses.tr: vi tiṣṭhantāṃ māturasyā upasthānnānārūpāḥ paśavo jāyamānāḥ sumaṅgalyupa sīdemamagniṃ saṃpatnī prati bhūṣeha devān
verses.en: Let many babes of varied form and nature spring in succession from this fruitful mother, Wait on this fire, thou bringer of good fortune. Here with thy husband serve the Gods with worship.

verses.sa:
सुमङ्गली प्रतरणी गृहाणां सुशेवा पत्ये श्वशुराय शंभूः ।
स्योना श्वश्र्वै प्र गृहान् विशेमान्॥
verses.tr: sumaṅgalī prataraṇī gṛhāṇāṃ suśevā patye śvaśurāya śaṃbhūḥ syonā śvaśrvai pra gṛhān viśemān
verses.en: Bliss-bringer, furthering thy household's welfare, dear, gladdening thy husband and his father, enter this home, mild to thy husband's mother,

verses.sa:
स्योना भव श्वशुरेभ्यः स्योना पत्ये गृहेभ्यः ।
स्योनास्यै सर्वस्यै विशे स्योना पुष्टायैषां भव॥
verses.tr: syonā bhava śvaśurebhyaḥ syonā patye gṛhebhyaḥ syonāsyai sarvasyai viśe syonā puṣṭāyaiṣāṃ bhava
verses.en: Be pleasant to thy husband's sire, sweet to thy household and thy lord. To all this clan be gentle, and favour these men's prosperity,

verses.sa:
सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूरिमां समेत पश्यत ।
सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वा दौर्भाग्यैर्विपरेतन॥
verses.tr: sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata saubhāgyamasyai dattvā daurbhāgyairviparetana
verses.en: Signs of good fortune mark the bride. Come all of you and look at her. Wish her prosperity: take on you her evil luck and go your way.

verses.sa:
या दुर्हार्दो युवतयो याश्चेह जरतीरपि ।
वर्चो न्वस्यै सं दत्ताथास्तं विपरेतन॥
verses.tr: yā durhārdo yuvatayo yāśceha jaratīrapi varco nvasyai saṃ dattāthāstaṃ viparetana
verses.en: Ye youthful maidens, ill-disposed, and all ye ancient women here, Give all your brilliance to the bride, then to your several homes depart!

verses.sa:
रुक्मप्रस्तरणं वह्यं विश्वा रूपाणि बिभ्रतम्।
आरोहत् सूर्या सावित्री बृहते सौभगाय कम्॥
verses.tr: rukmaprastaraṇaṃ vahyaṃ viśvā rūpāṇi bibhratam ārohat sūryā sāvitrī bṛhate saubhagāya kam
verses.en: Surya the child of Savitar mounted for high felicity Her litter with its cloth of gold, wearing all forms of loveliness,

verses.sa:
आ रोह तल्पं सुमनस्यमानेह प्रजां जनय पत्ये अस्मै।
इन्द्राणीव सुबुधा बुध्यमाना ज्योतिरग्रा उषसः प्रति जागरासि॥
verses.tr: ā roha talpaṃ sumanasyamāneha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai indrāṇīva subudhā budhyamānā jyotiragrā uṣasaḥ prati jāgarāsi
verses.en: Rise, mount the bridal bed with cheerful spirit. Here bring forth children to this man thy husband. Watchful and understanding like Indrani wake thou before the earliest light of Morning,

verses.sa:
देवा अग्रे न्यपद्यन्त पत्नीः समस्पृशन्त तन्वऽस्तनूभिः ।
सूर्येव नारि विश्वरूपा महित्वा प्रजावती पत्या सं भवेह॥
verses.tr: devā agre nyapadyanta patnīḥ samaspṛśanta tanva'stanūbhiḥ sūryeva nāri viśvarūpā mahitvā prajāvatī patyā saṃ bhaveha
verses.en: The Gods at first lay down beside their consorts; body with body met in close embracement, O Dame, like Surya perfect in her grandeur, here rich in future children, meet thy husband.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठेतो विश्वावसो नमसेडामहे त्वा ।
जामिमिच्छ पितृषदं न्यक्तां स ते भागो जनुषा तस्य विद्धि॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭheto viśvāvaso namaseḍāmahe tvā jāmimiccha pitṛṣadaṃ nyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi
verses.en: Rise and go hence, Visvavasu: with reverence we worship thee. Steal to her sister dwelling with her father: this is the share—mark this—of old assigned thee,

verses.sa:
अप्सरसः सधमादं मदन्ति हविर्धानमन्तरा सूर्यं च ।
तास्ते जनित्रमभि ताः परेहि नमस्ते गन्धर्वर्तुना कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: apsarasaḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti havirdhānamantarā sūryaṃ ca tāste janitramabhi tāḥ parehi namaste gandharvartunā kṛṇomi
verses.en: Apsarases rejoice and feast together between the sun and place of sacrificing. i These are thy kith and kin: go thou and join them: I in due season worship thee, Gandharva.

verses.sa:
नमो गन्धर्वस्य नमसे नमो भामाय चक्षुषे च कृण्मः ।
विश्वावसो ब्रह्मणा ते नमोऽभि जाया अप्सरसः परेहि॥
verses.tr: namo gandharvasya namase namo bhāmāya cakṣuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ viśvāvaso brahmaṇā te namo'bhi jāyā apsarasaḥ parehi
verses.en: Homage we pay to the Gandharva's favour, obeisance to his eye and fiery anger. Visvavasu, with prayer we pay thee homage. Go hence to those Apsarases thy consorts.

verses.sa:
राया वयं सुमनसः स्यामोदितो गन्धर्वमावीवृताम ।
अगन्त्स देवः परमं सधस्थमगन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: rāyā vayaṃ sumanasaḥ syāmodito gandharvamāvīvṛtāma agantsa devaḥ paramaṃ sadhasthamaganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: May we be happy with abundant riches, We from this place have banished the Gandharva. The God is gone to the remotest region, and we have come where men prolong existence.

verses.sa:
सं पितरावृत्विये सृजेथां माता पिता च रेतसो भवाथः ।
मर्य इव योषामधिरोहयैनां प्रजां कृण्वाथामिह पुष्यतं रयिम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ pitarāvṛtviye sṛjethāṃ mātā pitā ca retaso bhavāthaḥ marya iva yoṣāmadhirohayaināṃ prajāṃ kṛṇvāthāmiha puṣyataṃ rayim
verses.en: In your due season, Parents! come together. Mother and sire be ye of future children. Embrace this woman like a happy lover. Raise ye up offspring here: increase your riches.

verses.sa:
तां पूषंछिवतमामेरयस्व यस्यां बीजं मनुष्या३वपन्ति ।
या न ऊरू उशती विश्रयाति यस्यामुशन्तः प्रहरेम शेपः॥
verses.tr: tāṃ pūṣaṃchivatamāmerayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā3vapanti yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāti yasyāmuśantaḥ praharema śepaḥ
verses.en: Send her most rich in every charm, O Pusban, her who shall be the sharer of my pleasures; Her who shall twine her eager arms about me, and welcome all my love and soft embraces.

verses.sa:
आ रोहोरुमुप धत्स्व हस्तं परि ष्वजस्व जायां सुमनस्यमानः ।
प्रजां कृण्वाथामिह मोदमानौ दीर्घं वामायुः सविता कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: ā rohorumupa dhatsva hastaṃ pari ṣvajasva jāyāṃ sumanasyamānaḥ prajāṃ kṛṇvāthāmiha modamānau dīrghaṃ vāmāyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
verses.en: Up, happy bridegroom! with a joyous spirit caress thy wife and throw thine arm around her, Here take your pleasure, procreate your offspring. May Savitar bestow long life upon you.

verses.sa:
आ वां प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिरहोरात्राभ्यां समनक्त्वर्यमा।
अदुर्मङ्गली पतिलोकमा विशेमं शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatirahorātrābhyāṃ samanaktvaryamā adurmaṅgalī patilokamā viśemaṃ śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: So may the Lord of Life vouchsafe you children, Aryaman bind you, day and night, together, Enter thy husband's house with happy omens, bring blessing to our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
देवैर्दत्तं मनुना साकमेतद् वाधूयं वासो वध्वऽश्च वस्त्रम्।
यो ब्रह्मणे चिकितुषे ददाति स इद् रक्षांसि तल्पानि हन्ति॥
verses.tr: devairdattaṃ manunā sākametad vādhūyaṃ vāso vadhva'śca vastram yo brahmaṇe cikituṣe dadāti sa id rakṣāṃsi talpāni hanti
verses.en: Sent by the Gods associate with Manu, the vesture of the bride, the nuptial garment,—He who bestows this on a thoughtful Brahman, drives from the marriage-bed all evil demons,

verses.sa:
यं मे दत्तो ब्रह्मभागं वधूयोर्वाधूयं वासो वध्वऽश्च वस्त्रम्।
युवं ब्रह्मणेऽनुमन्यमानौ बृहस्पते साकमिन्द्रश्च दत्तम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ me datto brahmabhāgaṃ vadhūyorvādhūyaṃ vāso vadhva'śca vastram yuvaṃ brahmaṇe'numanyamānau bṛhaspate sākamindraśca dattam
verses.en: The priestly meed wherewith ye twain present me, the vesture of the bride, the nuptial garment,—This do ye both, Brihaspati and Indra, bestow with loving-kindness on the Brahman, l

verses.sa:
स्योनाद्योनेरधि बध्यमानौ हसामुदौ महसा मोदमानौ ।
सुगू सुपुत्रौ सुगृहौ तराथो जीवावुषसो विभातीः॥
verses.tr: syonādyoneradhi badhyamānau hasāmudau mahasā modamānau sugū suputrau sugṛhau tarātho jīvāvuṣaso vibhātīḥ
verses.en: On your soft couch awaking both together, revelling heartily with joy and laughter, Rich with brave sons, good cattle, goodly homestead, live long to look on many radiant mornings.

verses.sa:
नवं वसानः सुरभिः सुवासा उदागां जीव उषसो विभातीः ।
आण्डात् पतत्रीवामुक्षि विश्वस्मादेनसस्परि॥
verses.tr: navaṃ vasānaḥ surabhiḥ suvāsā udāgāṃ jīva uṣaso vibhātīḥ āṇḍāt patatrīvāmukṣi viśvasmādenasaspari
verses.en: Clad in new garment fragrant, well-apparelled, to meet refulgent Dawn have I arisen. I, like a bird that quits the egg, am freed from sin and purified.

verses.sa:
शुम्भनी द्यावापृथिवी अन्तिसुम्ने महिव्रते ।
आपः सप्त सुस्रुवुर्देवीस्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: śumbhanī dyāvāpṛthivī antisumne mahivrate āpaḥ sapta susruvurdevīstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Splendid are Heaven and Earth, still near to bless us, mighty in their power; The seven streams have flowed: may they, Goddesses, free us from distress,

verses.sa:
सूर्यायै देवेभ्यो मित्राय वरुणाय च ।
ये भूतस्य प्रचेतसस्तेभ्य इदमकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca ye bhūtasya pracetasastebhya idamakaraṃ namaḥ
verses.en: To Surya and the Deities, to Mitra and to Varuna, Who know aright the thing that is, this adoration have I paid.

verses.sa:
य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः ।
संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: ya ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasurniṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Bounteous Lord who healeth the dissevered parts,

verses.sa:
अपास्मत् तम उच्छतु नीलं पिशङ्गमुत लोहितं यत्।
निर्दहनी या पृषातक्य१स्मिन् तां स्थाणावध्या सजामि॥
verses.tr: apāsmat tama ucchatu nīlaṃ piśaṅgamuta lohitaṃ yat nirdahanī yā pṛṣātakya1smin tāṃ sthāṇāvadhyā sajāmi
verses.en: Let him flash gloom away from us, the blue, the yellow and the red. I fasten to this pillar here the burning pest prishata.

verses.sa:
यावतीः कृत्या उपवासने यावन्तो राज्ञो वरुणस्य पाशाः ।
व्यृद्धयो या असमृद्धयो या अस्मिन् ता स्थाणावधि सादयामि॥
verses.tr: yāvatīḥ kṛtyā upavāsane yāvanto rājño varuṇasya pāśāḥ vyṛddhayo yā asamṛddhayo yā asmin tā sthāṇāvadhi sādayāmi
verses.en: All witcheries that hang about this garment, all royal Varuna's entangling nooses, All failure of success and all misfortunes here I deposit fastened to the pillar.

verses.sa:
या मे प्रियतमा तनूः सा मे बिभाय वाससः ।
तस्याग्रे त्वं वनस्पते नीविं कृणुष्व मा वयं रिषाम॥
verses.tr: yā me priyatamā tanūḥ sā me bibhāya vāsasaḥ tasyāgre tvaṃ vanaspate nīviṃ kṛṇuṣva mā vayaṃ riṣāma
verses.en: My body that I hold most dear trembles in terror at this robe. Tree, make an apron at the top. Let no misfortune fall on us,

verses.sa:
ये अन्ता यावतीः सिचो य ओतवो ये च तन्तवः ।
वासो यत् पत्नीभिरुतं तन्नः स्योनमुप स्पृशात्॥
verses.tr: ye antā yāvatīḥ sico ya otavo ye ca tantavaḥ vāso yat patnībhirutaṃ tannaḥ syonamupa spṛśāt
verses.en: May all the hems and borders, all the threads that form the web and woof, The garment woven by the bride, be soft and pleasant to our touch,

verses.sa:
उशतीः कन्यला इमाः पितृलोकात् पतिं यतीः ।
अव दीक्षामसृक्षत स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: uśatīḥ kanyalā imāḥ pitṛlokāt patiṃ yatīḥ ava dīkṣāmasṛkṣata svāhā
verses.en: These maids who from their father's house have come with longing to their lord have let the preparation pass. All hail!

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
वर्चो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत् तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
तेजो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत् तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan varco goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan tejo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Her whom Brihaspati hath loosed the Visve Devas keep secure, With all the splendour that is stored in cows do we enrich this girl, Her whom Brihasbati hath loosed the Visve Devas keep secure. With all the vigour that is stored in cows do we enrich this girl,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
भजो गोषु प्रविष्टो यस्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan bhajo goṣu praviṣṭo yastenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Her whom Brihaspati, etc. With all good fortune, etc.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
यशो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत् तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan yaśo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Her whom Brihaspati, etc. With all the glory, etc,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
पयो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत् तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan payo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Her whom Brihaspati, etc. With all the milky store possessed by cows do we enrich this girl,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन्।
रसो गोषु प्रविष्टो यस्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan raso goṣu praviṣṭo yastenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Her whom Brihaspati hath freed the Visve Devas keep secure. With all the store of sap that cows contain do we enrich this girl,

verses.sa:
यदीमे केशिनो जना गृहे ते समनर्तिषू रोदेन कृण्वन्तो३घम्।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yadīme keśino janā gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvanto3gham agniṣṭvā tasmādenasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām
verses.en: If, wearing long loose hair, these men have danced together in thy house, committing sin with shout and cry. May Agni free thee from that guilt, may Savitar deliver thee,

verses.sa:
यदीयं दुहिता तव विकेश्यरुदद् गृहे रोदेन कृण्वत्य१घम्।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yadīyaṃ duhitā tava vikeśyarudad gṛhe rodena kṛṇvatya1gham agniṣṭvā tasmādenasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām
verses.en: If in thy house thy daughter have wept, with wild dishevelled locks, committing sin with her lament, May Agni, etc.

verses.sa:
यज्जामयो यद् युवतयो गृहे ते समनर्तिषू रोदेन कृण्वतीरघम्।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yajjāmayo yad yuvatayo gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvatīragham agniṣṭvā tasmādenasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām
verses.en: If the bride's sisters, if young maids have danced together in thy house, committing sin with shout and cry, May Agni free thee from that guilt, may Savitar deliver thee.

verses.sa:
यत् ते प्रजायां पशुषु यद् वा गृहेषु निष्ठितमघकृद्भिरघं कृतम्।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yat te prajāyāṃ paśuṣu yad vā gṛheṣu niṣṭhitamaghakṛdbhiraghaṃ kṛtam agniṣṭvā tasmādenasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām
verses.en: If any evil have been wrought by mischief-makers that affects thy cattle, progeny or house, May Agni free thee from the woe, may Savitar deliver thee.

verses.sa:
इयं नार्युप ब्रूते पूल्यान्यावपन्तिका।
दीर्घायुरस्तु मे पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ nāryupa brūte pūlyānyāvapantikā dīrghāyurastu me patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: This woman utters wish and prayer, as down she casts the husks of corn: Long live my lord and master! yea, a hundred autumns let him live!

verses.sa:
इहेमाविन्द्र सं नुद चक्रवाकेव दंपती ।
प्रजयैनौ स्वस्तकौ विश्वमायुर्व्यऽश्नुताम्॥
verses.tr: ihemāvindra saṃ nuda cakravākeva daṃpatī prajayainau svastakau viśvamāyurvya'śnutām
verses.en: Join thou this couple, Indra! like the Chakravaka and his mate: May they attain to full old age with children in their happy home,

verses.sa:
यदासन्द्यामुपधाने यद् वोपवासने कृतम्।
विवाहे कृत्यां यां चक्रुरास्नाने तां नि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: yadāsandyāmupadhāne yad vopavāsane kṛtam vivāhe kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrurāsnāne tāṃ ni dadhmasi
verses.en: Whatever magic hath been wrought on cushion, chair, or canopy, Each spell to mar the wedding rites, all this we throw into the bath.

verses.sa:
यद् दुष्कृतं यच्छमलं विवाहे वहतौ च यत्।
तत् संभलस्य कम्बले मृज्महे दुरितं वयम्॥
verses.tr: yad duṣkṛtaṃ yacchamalaṃ vivāhe vahatau ca yat tat saṃbhalasya kambale mṛjmahe duritaṃ vayam
verses.en: Whatever fault or error was in marriage or in bridal pomp, This woe we wipe away upon the cloak the interceder wears,

verses.sa:
संभले मलं सादयित्वा कम्बले दुरितं वयम्।
अभूम यज्ञियाः शुद्धाः प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: saṃbhale malaṃ sādayitvā kambale duritaṃ vayam abhūma yajñiyāḥ śuddhāḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: We, having laid the stain and fault upon the intereeder's cloak, Are pure and meet for sacrifice, May he prolong our lives for us,

verses.sa:
कृत्रिमः कण्टकः शतदन् य एषः ।
अपास्याः केश्यं मलमप शीर्षण्यं लिखात्॥
verses.tr: kṛtrimaḥ kaṇṭakaḥ śatadan ya eṣaḥ apāsyāḥ keśyaṃ malamapa śīrṣaṇyaṃ likhāt
verses.en: Now let this artificial comb, wrought with a hundred teeth, remove: Aught of impurity that dims the hair upon this woman's head.

verses.sa:
अङ्गादङ्गाद् वयमस्या अप यक्ष्मं नि दध्मसि ।
तन्मा प्रापत् पृथिवीं मोत देवान् दिवं मा प्रापदुर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
अपो मा प्रापन्मलमेतदग्ने यमं मा प्रापत् पितॄंश्च सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: aṅgādaṅgād vayamasyā apa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi tanmā prāpat pṛthivīṃ mota devān divaṃ mā prāpadurva1ntarikṣam apo mā prāpanmalametadagne yamaṃ mā prāpat pitṝṃśca sarvān
verses.en: We. take away Consumption from each limb and member of the bride, Let not this reach Earth, nor the Gods in heaven, let it not reach the sky or air's wide region, Let not this dust that sullies reach the Waters, nor Yama, Agni, nor the host of Fathers.

verses.sa:
सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसा पृथिव्याः सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसौषधीनाम्।
सं त्वा नह्यामि प्रजया धनेन सा संनद्धा सनुहि वाजमेमम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasauṣadhīnām saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena sā saṃnaddhā sanuhi vājamemam
verses.en: With all the milk that is in Earth I gird thee, with all the milk that Plants contain I dress thee. I gird thee round with children and with riches, Do thou, thus girt, receive the offered treasure,

verses.sa:
अमोऽहमस्मि सा त्वं सामाहमस्म्यृक् त्वं द्यौरहं पृथिवी त्वम्।
ताविह सं भवाव प्रजामा जनयावहै॥
verses.tr: amo'hamasmi sā tvaṃ sāmāhamasmyṛk tvaṃ dyaurahaṃ pṛthivī tvam tāviha saṃ bhavāva prajāmā janayāvahai
verses.en: I am this man, that dame art thou: I ana the psalm and thou the verse, I am the heaven and thou the earth, So will we dwell together here, parents of children yet to be,

verses.sa:
जनियन्ति नावग्रवः पुत्रियन्ति सुदानवः ।
अरिष्टासू सचेवहि बृहते वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: janiyanti nāvagravaḥ putriyanti sudānavaḥ ariṣṭāsū sacevahi bṛhate vājasātaye
verses.en: Unmarried men desire to wed; bountiful givers wish for sons. Together may we dwell with strength unscathed for high prosperity.

verses.sa:
ये पितरो वधूदर्शा इमं वहतुमागमन्।
ते अस्यै वध्वै संपत्न्यै प्रजावच्छर्म यच्छन्तु॥
verses.tr: ye pitaro vadhūdarśā imaṃ vahatumāgaman te asyai vadhvai saṃpatnyai prajāvaccharma yacchantu
verses.en: May they, the Fathers who, to view the bride, have joined this nuptial train, Grant to this lady and her lord children and peaceful happiness,

verses.sa:
येदं पूर्वागन् रशनायमाना प्रजामस्यै द्रविणं चेह दत्त्वा।
तां वहन्त्वगतस्यानु पन्थां विराडियं सुप्रजा अत्यजैषीत्॥
verses.tr: yedaṃ pūrvāgan raśanāyamānā prajāmasyai draviṇaṃ ceha dattvā tāṃ vahantvagatasyānu panthāṃ virāḍiyaṃ suprajā atyajaiṣīt
verses.en: Her who first guided by a rein came hither, giving the bride here offspring and possessions, Let them convey along the futures pathway. Splendid, with noble children, she hath conquered.

verses.sa:
प्र बुध्यस्व सुबुधा बुध्यमाना दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ।
गृहान् गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो दीर्घं त आयुः सविता कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: pra budhyasva subudhā budhyamānā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya gṛhān gaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso dīrghaṃ ta āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
verses.en: Wake to long life, watchful and understanding, yea, to a life shall last a hundred autumns. Enter the house to be the household's mistress, A long long life let Savitar vouchsafe thee,
